notes.title: Devlog #01
notes.content:
Decided to take a break from development for a while and write the first devlog. The most important thing is that work is progressing rapidly, and almost every day (except Sunday 😉), the game is moving towards release. I'm a proponent of the expression "show, don't tell," so let's get straight to some of the things we've been working on lately:

Added ziplining mechanics. I'm really excited to have this feature in the game. Levels have become much more interesting and varied, and most importantly, backtracking has been minimized. Yay!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/b357f70ca0b742a3a386aa12372e40d1930b9386.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/b357f70ca0b742a3a386aa12372e40d1930b9386.gif[/img][/url]

In a 2D platformer where the main mechanics are stealth, it's hard to come up with a lot of diverse enemies, and at times like this, the good old laser comes to the rescue
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/00e3eb4598c3f08c5bf4fca283fa7bb5c3bccee8.gif[/img]

Sketches of new levels, and I also redid the old ones for the millionth time
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/5e65fce11bcfcf3d3683e06674c28fa686a655f5.jpg[/img]

Did a lot of tests of [b]Just Hide[/b] on Steam Deck. The game runs great and will have full compatibility
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/420a6a95faec7f5b84367003d6680a11016548d6.jpg[/img]

My other half, who is the second and last member of our team, brought the animation to the final version
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/acbd75421710d95c36d0a4b50662692ae8ade845.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/70105ff186fceb5ce523d3638d5b4e7c88a7cda6.gif[/img]
[i]Left as it was, right as it became in the example of running[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/008dea0be3d20a05eb3cc46708c546bf57854e59.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/4a81a30eb76a5a4783fecabfe5520bb8dce7e6e1.gif[/img]
[i]Left as it was, right as it became in the example of squat walking[/i]

The missing sprites have been drawn. Previously, when using binoculars on a pipe or staircase, a picture of a character standing on the ground was used. Now all the missing images have been drawn
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/12daf9c552f3dd77ba64f2000f3356ecfb7b5f64.png[/img]
Work on backgrounds for locations is in full swing
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/b6218721a2cf658c16a9c53d7eb2078034afd939.jpg[/img]]Updated desert background (not the final result)[/i]

And the most important innovation! Now the force of throwing a sonic grenade will be graphically displayed! 🤪
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600825/75539f19ce1fd89173092d64aee8769943441636.gif[/img]

That's the end of the first devlog. Thank you for adding [b]Just Hide[/b] to the wishlist! 😉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590190/Just_Hide/
